about: The graduale of the formulary “Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Today ye shall know that the Lord will come and save us, and in the morning ye shall see His glory. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou Who leadest Joseph like a sheep; Thou Who sittest above the Cherubim, show Thyself before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasses.
